description: Language Server integration, syntax highlighting, diagnostics, navigation, and IntelliSense for Tyrus.

title: supOS DevTools
description: A VS Code extension for supOS with remote programmable component pulling, automatic synchronization, API type hints, and code completion.

description: View NPY, NPZ, Safetensors and GGUF files: shapes, dtypes, stats and heatmaps. Offline.

title: HDF5 NetCDF Explorer
description: Open HDF5 and NetCDF files (.h5, .hdf5, .nc): browse groups, attributes and CF metadata, page through values and plot 1D and 2D slices. Offline.

title: Git Profile & PortableGit Workspace Switcher
description: Dynamically switch Git commit author, GitHub push credentials, and PortableGit/<username> repositories with zero identity mismatch.

title: LineCue
description: Read errors and warnings inline while coding, using existing VS Code diagnostics.

description: Open Word .docx and .dotx files in VS Code as a read-only preview with dark mode, a heading outline, search, tables, images and footnotes. Copy as Markdown or open as plain text. Works offline.

title: ChatGPT Theme 99%
description: An unofficial dark VS Code color theme by SHEZON with a calm charcoal palette and blue highlights, designed for VS Code and compatible color import into Hermes Desktop.
